name: Organization of American States
body: DMARC quarantines spoofed mail, http redirects permanently to https, and every internal link opened answered. But the English home page has no viewport meta tag, so phones draw it as a shrunken desktop page.
lesson: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> to every page template.
summary: www.oas.org scores 62 out of 100 (D). 3 checks fail now, 34 are at risk, and 12 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on 19 of 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 25 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /ext/en/main/oas/our-structure/agencies-and-entities/tribad/, /OOCPP/default.aspx?lang=en, /ext/en/tools/sigmandates, /ext/en/tools/Calendar-Conferences and 2 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: The start page has no viewport tag
fix.evidence: Without it, phones render the desktop layout zoomed out. Google indexes the mobile version first.

fix.title: 4 cookies are sent without Secure, and 5 session cookies are readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: dnn_IsMobile, language, __RequestVerificationToken_L2V4dA2, ASP.NET_SessionId. Without HttpOnly: ASPSESSIONIDAWRDARAD, ASPSESSIONIDQGQADRDC, ASPSESSIONIDCUQCAQBB, ASPSESSIONIDSEQDDTCD and 1 more. A script injected into the page could steal…
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: 68 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on 13 of 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 477 ms
The start page reads well without JavaScript
